articles.title: Anthropic expected to receive high ‘junk’ rating from credit agencies following IPO, FT report says
articles.description: Blackstone's forecast is just a prediction, but naturally, a high junk rating would make it more difficult and costlier for Anthropic to raise the money to keep funding its massive spending that has undergirded its business.
articles.author: Lucas Ropek

articles.title: AI execs may be too out of touch to build for the general public
articles.description: Tech leaders are flaunting how out of touch they are when they brag about using AI to connect with their families.
articles.author: Amanda Silberling

articles.title: As search traffic dries up, Reddit announces it’s shifting to a logged-in experience
articles.description: As AI transforms how people find information online, Reddit is rethinking its open-web roots to protect its audience and business.
articles.author: Sarah Perez

articles.title: Cohere says Alibaba’s Qwen model tried to send a file to Beijing
articles.description: An AI model said it wouldn’t use any tools, then tried to send something to a server in Beijing anyway, and while researchers say it’s probably a training quirk and not espionage, the whole thing has people asking how much to trust free Chinese AI.
articles.author: Aditya Mehta

articles.title: Grok releases the first seven minutes of its AI-generated ‘Odyssey’
articles.description: The footage looks okay, as long as you're not seeking artistry, inspiration, or human interest.
articles.author: Anthony Ha

articles.title: Google’s first data center satellite is online and writing poetry
articles.description: The first TPU in space is running a Google DeepMind Gemma 4 model and writing cheesy poetry.
articles.author: Tim Fernholz

articles.title: DoorDash said it’s only received ‘several hundred’ orders from AI agents
articles.description: DoorDash said that it is open to working with third-party agent makers.
articles.author: Ivan Mehta

articles.title: Microsoft just shared Azure’s actual revenue in dollars: $33.2 billion
articles.description: Microsoft has never disclosed Azure's quarterly revenue in dollars. But for the first time, we can see just how close it is getting to besting the biggest competitor in the market, AWS.
articles.author: Aditya Mehta

articles.title: Microsoft recorded $10 billion in revenue from OpenAI
articles.description: Microsoft said it made $10 billion in revenue from commercial arrangements with OpenAI, including revenue-sharing payments, in the quarter ending September 30. It underscores the still-enormous financial dependency of the partnership.
articles.author: Rebecca Bellan

articles.title: AI delivers ‘zero financial payoff’ to most companies, Apollo economist says
articles.description: "Despite massive investments and widespread hype around artificial intelligence, the technology has delivered zero financial payoff to corporate America outside of tech."
articles.author: Anthony Ha
